blocks.t: Multi-awarded AI Care Partner in Healthcare
A look at the recognition we’ve been fortunate to receive along the way.
Newsweek AI Impact Awards 2026
Heidi Won the AI Health Care - Best Outcomes, Physician Satisfaction

Newsweek recognized Heidi in the AI Health Category for best outcomes and physician satisfaction. The award was judged by a panel of healthcare and AI experts across 48 categories in the 2026 program.
Becker's Great Leaders in Healthcare
Recognized as one of the leading companies in healthcare

Becker’s, a trusted voice in healthcare business news and leadership, has named Heidi one of the leading companies in healthcare. This recognition places Heidi among a select group of organizations shaping patient care innovation and operational excellence.
Best in KLAS 2026
Debuted as a New Vendor for KLAS
Heidi has officially entered the healthcare industry’s most respected vendor rankings with an impressive 93.1/100 overall score in the Ambient Speech category.
2026 North American Technology Innovation Leadership
Awarded for excellence in innovation, strategy execution, and clinician impact across the medical scribe industry.

Frost and Sullivan recognized Heidi with the 2026 North American Technology Innovation Leadership Award for AI medical scribing. The recognition highlights Heidi’s position as one of the leading AI medical scribes in the region, built on real clinician outcomes.
CHIME Foundation 2025
Named CHIME’s 2025 Foundation Partner of the Year at the CHIME25 Fall Forum

CHIME named Heidi its 2025 Foundation Partner of the Year at the CHIME25 Fall Forum in San Antonio. Despite only CHIME in 2025, Heidi stood out for putting the physician experience at the center of everything it builds.

blocks.t: Frequently Asked Questions About Heidi
Answers to the most common questions about Heidi and what they mean for clinicians
What is Heidi?

Heidi is a multi-product AI care partner built around Scribe, Evidence, and Remote. It covers documentation, evidence-backed clinical answers, patient communications, and dedicated hardware for any care setting. It works across 200+ specialties in 110+ languages and connects with major EHR systems to support clinicians at every step of the clinical day.
